text:
This run cannot answer which hiring plan meets both objectives, because the **£400k/year salary limit was not checkable**.

- All four options were analysed as having no stated effect on annual salary spend, including two seniors and four juniors; those figures are currently unknown.
- The remaining delivery comparison is provisional and fragile: every material estimate is machine-authored, and the model has not recorded whether more platform delivery is the intended goal direction.
- Incremental delivery capacity is a key Olumi estimate; changing it can alter the comparison, but investigation priority is not established from this alone.
